static_traits.name: Jiang Ming
static_traits.family_status: Mother was once a famous ballet Actor in London; others Not mentioned
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness;not yet received psychotherapy;without similar problem history
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, clear expression, high cooperation; initially slightly tense; able to describe Anxiety and worries concretely; willing to try journaling and examining thoughts

basic_info.main_problem: I was recently robbed at a gas station, and since then believe I can never save any money again, thus feeling persistent Anxiety and unease.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to reduce the Fear and Anxiety about financial insecurity and rebuild a sense of financial security for the future.
growth_experiences: Family-of-origin information: Mother was once a famous ballet Actor in London; remaining developmental experiences Not mentioned.

core_beliefs: I am unable to guarantee my own financial security
I am destined to fail at saving money

special_situations.event: On night shifts, alone at the gas station, repeatedly recalls the robbery experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I am Being alone on night shifts, another incident is very likely, and any money saved will be taken away
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises vigilance, focuses on potential risks at work; tries to gain a sense of safety by cutting expenses and budgeting
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something will go wrong again; my savings will be emptied again

special_situations.event: When thinking about financial problems, focuses only on the losses caused by being robbed, ignoring the fact of having successfully saved money before
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One loss means efforts to save money have no meaning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly focusing on negative cues, avoiding discussing with others to avoid being questioned
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Past savings do not count; everything changed after this time

special_situations.event: When evaluating savings plans, uses whether it is absolutely safe as the standard
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot avoid risks 100%, then I can never save money
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Taking extreme cost-cutting and budgeting, but negating their value due to Fear
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Either completely safe or a total failure

special_situations.event: Inferring one's future financial fate from one robbery experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One negative event means it will always be like this in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Assuming the worst outcome in advance to Self-protect, reducing sense of investment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something will always go wrong later; savings will eventually be destroyed

core_conflict.wish: Longs for stable financial and personal safety, and controllability over life
core_conflict.fear: Fears experiencing robbery and financial loss again; worries any effort will be destroyed
defense_goal: Seeks a sense of control through strict budgeting and reducing expenses
Reducing confiding in others to avoid exposing vulnerability

object_relations.object_representation: Others are bystanders, not necessarily able to understand or provide protection

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to share in detail with colleagues or friends the worries and feelings after the robbery
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe sharing is useless or burdens others, thus choosing to bear it alone
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a brief, restrained tone, reducing details; when pressed, using 'it is fine''I can handle it myself' to close the topic, avoiding deep emotional expression.

manifestations: Anxiety intensified when Being alone on night shifts, repeatedly recalling the robbery
Hard to open up to colleagues and friends about the extent of financial worries

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, that is, redirects the energy originally meant to be sent outward back toward the self.
manifestations: Not fully sharing the extent of financial Anxiety with close friends
Turning worries and pressure into self-draining rumination when Being alone on night shifts

positive_force: Once successfully saved and had some money management and budgeting strategies (before the robbery)
Has one close friend to talk with (potential support)
Actively seeks help and is willing to participate in counseling, positive attitude
negative_force: Cognitive distortions like catastrophizing, overgeneralization, black-and-white, and mental filtering maintaining Anxiety
Repeatedly recalling the robbery when Being alone on night shifts, significantly decreased sense of security
Sleep disturbance and Decreased appetite causing impaired functioning
Difficulty opening up to colleagues and friends, Insufficient use of social support

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and repeated worries related to financial insecurity
antecedent: Working the night shift alone at a gas station
Thinking about future finances and savings
target_behavior.core_reason: High-pressure stress after the robbery and catastrophic, overgeneralizing, and future-predicting cognition about financial loss
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential danger; maintains vigilance and control through worry
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety, Decline in work performance, difficulty focusing

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbance(Difficulty falling asleep,Declining sleep quality)
antecedent: After night shifts or before sleep, repeatedly worries about finances and safety
High-pressure Anxiety during Work continuing into the night
target_behavior.core_reason: Excessive worry and Fear about future financial insecurity causing heightened physiological arousal
target_behavior.function: Staying vigilant in a self-perceived effort to avoid risk
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening fatigue, Decreased attention, Work performance affected

antecedent: Intense Anxiety during Work or when thinking about financial problems
target_behavior.core_reason: Anxiety activation causing somatic reactions and Reduced motivation to eat
target_behavior.consequence: Nutrition intake decreases, physical fitness declines, further affecting work and life

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids self-exposure in interpersonal interactions (difficult to fully talk about worries with colleagues and friends)
antecedent: When asked about the impact of the robbery
Situations of trying to ask others for help or share worries
target_behavior.core_reason: Believing sharing is useless or adds burden to others, worrying about being unable to gain support
target_behavior.function: Avoids embarrassment or being misunderstood; maintains safe boundaries for vulnerability
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient use of social support, maintained Anxiety and insecurity
